title: Users
subtitle: Every account on Cove Studio, across every academy.

table.search: Search by name, email, or number

action.reason_hint: Recorded on the audit trail. Write what a colleague would need to understand this later.

role_change.body: The new role takes effect at once. They are signed out of anything the old role gave them, and their work is kept.
role_change.body_multi_one: Pick the role for this academy. It is written only if you change it.
role_change.body_multi_other: This account belongs to more than one academy, so pick the role for each. Only the ones you change are written.

operator.confirm_grant_body: They get every permission on Cove Studio: every academy, every account, and the ability to suspend and delete. Grant it to colleagues, never to customers.
operator.confirm_revoke_body: They lose the console at once. Their academy memberships and roles are untouched.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in again until an operator restores the account.
delete.stakes: This locks the account. It does not erase the person: memberships, submissions and history are all kept, and an operator can restore it.

detail.subtitle: Who this person is, where they belong, and what they do there.
detail.memberships_empty_body: This account has not joined an academy yet.
detail.invitations_empty_body: Nothing has been sent to this address.
detail.join_requests_empty_body: This account has not applied to an academy.
detail.confirm_suspend_body: They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you restore the account. Their work and memberships are kept.
detail.confirm_restore_body: They can sign in again straight away, with the academies and roles they had.

participation.loading: Loading what this person does here
participation.forbidden: Reading what someone does inside an academy needs the participation permission. Ask an operator who has it, or open a support grant.
participation.open_academy: Open this academy in the console
participation.no_class_body: Enrol them from the academy's classes page — until then they have nothing to open.
participation.no_taught_body: No class in this academy has them as its teacher.
participation.no_courses_body: This account has not created a course in this academy.

activity.title: Activity
activity.forbidden: Reading the audit trail needs the audit permission.
activity.failed: The audit trail could not be reached. Try again shortly.
activity.empty_body: No act by or upon this account has been written to the trail.

unavailable.title: People are unavailable
unavailable.body: The platform could not be reached. Try again shortly.
